description:
Fetch a resource gated behind x402 and complete the payment flow to obtain it -- the x402 CLIENT walk, which none of the other tools here perform. GET url: if it answers 200 directly, the resource was free (outcome no_payment_required -- not a failure, x402 gates specific endpoints, not the whole internet). If it answers 402, parses the PAYMENT-REQUIRED manifest, downloads a STARK proof from proof_url (defaulted to the published demo proof only when url's host is demo.pay.vauban.tech; REQUIRED for any other host -- never guessed), gunzips it in memory, and POSTs it back to url.
PROOF SOURCE: the proof submitted is the one the merchant PRE-GENERATED and published. A 'paid' outcome carries proof.honesty stating what the resulting 200 establishes (a real STARK verification, really bound to the settlement) and its scope (the proof and the settlement are the merchant's published ones, not this agent's).
Four outcomes, never conflated: no_payment_required (free), paid (200 after proof -- content + receipt + manifest + honesty label), refused (402 again after the proof was submitted -- the server's own reason, verbatim: a result, not a crash), unreachable (transport failure or an unrecognized HTTP status -- says nothing about the merchant). A missing proof_url on a non-demo host that requires payment returns a plain input error instead, since no request was ever sent to guess at.
STANDARD x402 v2 (since 0.7.0): if the 402 carries the x402 foundation's PaymentRequired document (standard base64 of JSON, x402Version 2) with an exact offer on a Starknet network, this tool pays it the standard way instead: the configured Starknet account signs a SNIP-9 authorization for exactly that transfer, the merchant's facilitator settles it and pays the gas, and the same GET is retried with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. A 'paid' outcome then carries standard{scheme, network, payTo, amount, asset, payer, feePayer}, the facilitator's receipt (transaction, network, payer) and an honesty note: value moved from THIS agent's account, no STARK proof was verified, and the transaction must be read back from a Starknet node before it is believed. Fifth outcome, unpayable: the offer is fine but this server cannot pay it (no Starknet signer configured, a token other than STRK unless PAY_MCP_STANDARD_X402_ASSETS (<CAIP-2>/<token>) lists it (code starknet_asset_not_allowed), payee not in PAY_MCP_STANDARD_X402_PAYEES which fails closed when empty, amount above PAY_MCP_STANDARD_X402_MAX_WEI (atomic units of the token paid; unset, 0.1 STRK for STRK and a refusal for any other token, code starknet_cap_unset_for_asset), the day's count spent (PAY_MCP_STANDARD_X402_MAX_PER_DAY, one count for the whole server process, code daily_budget_spent), an offer whose maxTimeoutSeconds is above 900 s (code authorization_window_too_long), or no Starknet offer) -- a fact about this server, never about the merchant. On every Starknet scheme, a 'refused' that comes after the signature carries authorization_outstanding: true and execute_before: the authorization stays executable by the offer's feePayer until then, so do not pay again before it. On exact and exact-pq, an answer after presentation that is neither 200 nor 402 (an HTTP 502, say), or no answer at all, is indeterminate with do_not_repay: true, authorization_outstanding: true and execute_before: it may have settled.
EXACT-CCTP (off by default): with PAY_MCP_EXACT_CCTP=1, an exact-cctp offer on starknet:SN_SEPOLIA (or starknet:SN_MAIN, see MAINNET below) is taken before exact. In Falcon card mode it is taken only when PAY_MCP_EXACT_CCTP_FALCON=1 is set as well (otherwise Falcon mode pays exact-pq only, code falcon_requires_exact_pq); the card then signs the same two calls, no ML-DSA-65 intent is sent, and on starknet:SN_MAIN the card must also be listed in PAY_MCP_FALCON_MAINNET_CARDS with a date to come (code cctp_falcon_card_not_mainnet, before any budget is used). The configured Starknet account signs a SNIP-9 authorization for exactly two calls, approve then deposit_for_burn_with_hook on Circle's CCTP V2, and the merchant is paid in USDC on Base Sepolia (eip155:84532) by a mint. It signs only when the offer's asset and payTo are the USDC and TokenMessengerMinterV2 this client pins for the offer's network, the destination is the one pinned for it (Base Sepolia for Sepolia, Base for mainnet, CCTP domain 6) and destination_caller is zero ; otherwise unpayable with code cctp_asset_not_pinned, cctp_pay_to_not_pinned, cctp_destination_network_not_pinned, cctp_destination_domain_not_pinned or cctp_destination_caller_not_zero. The merchant (extra.destination_pay_to) must be in PAY_MCP_EXACT_CCTP_PAYEES (fails closed when empty, code cctp_destination_not_allowed) and the amount at most PAY_MCP_EXACT_CCTP_MAX_UNITS atomic USDC (code cctp_over_cap); extra.max_fee above 100 basis points of the amount is refused (code cctp_max_fee_above_bound). MAINNET is closed even then: an offer on starknet:SN_MAIN paying Base (eip155:8453) is unpayable (code cctp_mainnet_not_enabled) unless PAY_MCP_EXACT_CCTP_MAINNET=1 is also set; it then also needs the merchant listed as eip155:8453:<address> (a bare address or '*' never counts for mainnet), PAY_MCP_EXACT_CCTP_MAX_UNITS set (no default, code cctp_mainnet_cap_unset), PAY_MCP_EXACT_CCTP_MAINNET_MAX_DAILY_UNITS set (atomic USDC per UTC day for all mainnet payments of the process, no default, codes cctp_mainnet_daily_cap_unset and cctp_mainnet_daily_cap_spent) and extra.destination_asset equal to Circle's USDC on Base (code cctp_destination_asset_not_pinned). Next to an exact offer, a mainnet exact-cctp offer that is not enabled is skipped and exact is paid. A 'paid' outcome carries cctp{scheme, network, amount, asset, destination_network, destination_pay_to, max_fee, offer_id, payer, feePayer}, the receipt, cross_chain_leg (the facilitator's word on the Base mint, status minted with mint_tx or attested) and an honesty note. Any answer after presentation that is neither 200 nor 402 is indeterminate with do_not_repay: true and burn_tx when the facilitator names one: the amount may already be burnt, and it mints to the merchant later.
EVM: an exact offer on an eip155 network (e.g. USDC on Base) is paid with an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization signed by the payer key held in a Web3 keystore (PAY_MCP_EVM_KEYSTORE_PATH + PAY_MCP_EVM_PASSWORD_PATH, never a key in the environment), or, instead of a keystore, by an ERC-1271 post-quantum account (PAY_MCP_EVM_PQ_ACCOUNT, ML-DSA-44 seed file, nodes in PAY_MCP_EVM_RPC_URLS); the merchant's facilitator reports broadcasting it and paying the gas. Closed by default: the network must be listed in PAY_MCP_EVM_NETWORKS, the payTo in PAY_MCP_EVM_PAYEES ('*' pays any payee, up to the session cap: avoid it), a value network such as eip155:8453 also needs PAY_MCP_EVM_I_ACCEPT_MAINNET_SPEND naming it, PAY_MCP_EVM_MAX_PER_PAYMENT and PAY_MCP_EVM_MAX_PER_SESSION (atomic units, no default) cap each payment and the session, and only the network's known USDC is payable unless PAY_MCP_EVM_ASSETS (<CAIP-2>/<token>) says otherwise. Every EVM exact offer is examined and the payable one with the smallest atomic amount is taken (a comparison that is only meaningful between tokens with the same decimals). A signed authorization handed over is counted against the session cap and never credited back: a 'refused' outcome carries authorization_outstanding: true, because the authorization stays spendable until valid_before. A 'paid' outcome carries the facilitator's receipt fields (success, transaction, network, errorReason, payer), with the raw header in receipt_raw, and evm{network, chainId, asset, payTo, amount, payer, nonce, validBefore}. Sixth outcome, indeterminate: the signed authorization was presented and the answer does not establish whether money moved (HTTP 502, settlement_pending, a refusal naming a transaction, a lost answer, or any other answer that is not a readable refusal, a fresh 402 included). It carries do_not_repay: true and the transaction hash when there is one: never pay again before checking it.

network.description: Optional CAIP-2 network to pay on when the 402 offers several (e.g. eip155:84532 for Base Sepolia, starknet:SN_SEPOLIA). Without it, Starknet is the reference: the Starknet offer is taken when a Starknet signer is configured; an EVM offer is taken when only an EVM payer is configured (a keystore, PAY_MCP_EVM_KEYSTORE_PATH, or a post-quantum account, PAY_MCP_EVM_PQ_ACCOUNT) or when no Starknet offer exists.

proof_url.description: Where to download a pre-generated, gzipped STARK proof to submit. Defaults to the published demo proof when url's host is demo.pay.vauban.tech. REQUIRED for any other host.
